title.zh: 教程：建立更多的殖民地

excerpt.zh:

title.zh: 教程：建立更多的殖民地

texts.zh:
以建立£colony£殖民地的方式继续扩张我们的帝国。我们有充足的£alloys£合金、£food£食物和£consumer_goods£消费品时，就[GetBuildGrowCap]更多£colony_ship£殖民船，然后让它们去建立更多殖民地。

小心，不要在殖民地发展阶段同时建立过多的殖民地，因为他们能够自己自足之前一直会消耗£energy£能量币。
texts.en:
Continue to expand our empire by founding new £colony£ Colonies. [GetBuildGrowCap] more £colony_ship£ Colony Ships when we have enough £alloys£ Alloys, £food£ Food, and £consumer_goods£ Consumer Goods then send them off to establish new colonies.

Take care not to have too many colonies under development at the same time, since they drain £energy£ Energy Credits until they become self-sufficient.
